hero.statement: I build the distributed systems and async engines behind money movement, AI tooling, and high-availability platforms.
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer with 6+ years designing and operating production systems for fintech, applied AI, and enterprise platforms. I specialize in TypeScript/Node.js, Python, and event-driven architecture on AWS/GCP — from high-volume payment gateways to multi-agent orchestration across isolated VPCs.
I care about clean boundaries, observable systems, and shipping outcomes. Italian (EU) citizen, authorized to work in the EU without sponsorship; remote across CET and EST.
hero.competencies: Distributed systems · Event-driven architecture · Asynchronous processing · Idempotency & resilience · Agentic AI orchestration · Cloud-native operations

experience.title: Where I've shipped
experience.subtitle: Production systems across fintech, applied AI, and cloud infrastructure.

bullets: Designed and shipped a distributed asynchronous engine for regulatory reports in Fastify and Python, moving generation off the request path with BullMQ and Redis, idempotent workers, and observable job processing.
Co-designed the agentic core for AI tool distribution — multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous execution loops — with token-authenticated M2M APIs between isolated VPCs.
Built a secure event pipeline between isolated customer VPCs and the central platform, with distributed workers, consistency guarantees, and no public endpoints.
Standardized agent-assisted SDLC workflows, shortening microservice refactoring cycles and expanding automated test coverage.
Operated distributed services across AWS and GCP, containerized with Docker and delivered through zero-downtime CI/CD with Sentry and CloudWatch observability.

Built the end-to-end cross-platform mobile architecture (iOS and Android) in React Native and TypeScript for a credit origination platform, delivering 20+ modular screens: biometric KYC onboarding, analytics, transactions, history, and real-time chat.
Designed and operated the cloud data layer, implementing authentication and granular Row-Level Security (RLS) policies to protect sensitive credit histories and financial contracts.
Improved cold-start load time and added offline persistence for loan applications and transactions in low-connectivity environments.
Maintained high availability across mission-critical payment gateway services handling high-volume transactions in Node.js (Express), TypeScript, and MySQL.
Engineered financial resilience and idempotency with circuit breakers, rate limiting, and AWS SQS queues with dead-letter queues (DLQ), preventing duplicate charges during banking gateway outages.
Reduced p95 transaction latency by optimizing complex MySQL queries, offloading notifications to asynchronous SQS workers, and refactoring critical endpoints.
Led payment gateway integrations for merchants and partners across React web apps and REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, backed by Jest test suites and Datadog/Sentry monitoring.
Designed and developed 3 modular internal applications in JavaScript, Node.js, and Python for commercial operations, used daily in production.
Maintained high availability on production Linux servers with NGINX reverse proxies, load balancing, and SSL/TLS policies.
Reduced developer onboarding time by standardizing 15+ API contracts and system blueprints with OpenAPI/Swagger.
